recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, binary black-and-white composition featuring a central, highly distorted vertical figure resembling a totem or a figure in ornate dress, flanked by deep negative space and a secondary, ethereal smoke-like form on the left. The aesthetic is defined by extreme thresholding that eliminates mid-tones, creating a gritty, xerographic texture.
coreVisualRelationships: Central vertical axis anchoring the composition
Organic, fluid smoke form balancing the rigid central figure
Extreme binary contrast between pure black and textured white
Typographic cluster floating in the upper right quadrant
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain and dust textures
Deep black background occupying at least 70% of the canvas
Vertical orientation of the primary subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A thin, ornate vertical column-like figure is centered horizontally; a secondary abstract form sits in the upper left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central vertical figure acts as the primary anchor, drawing the eye from top to bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright smoke form on the left, moves to the central totem, and finishes at the text block in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant solid black background creates a sense of isolation and mystery.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: High-intensity white for all subjects and text

letterConstructionRules: Top line: Fluid, lowercase-heavy cursive with thick, rounded strokes.
Bottom line: All-caps, blocky sans-serif with a slight upward arc.
Both lines feature a 'bleeding' or 'ink-spread' texture.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are slightly distorted as if viewed through water or heat

composition.warp: Slight upward arc on the second line

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between organic script and rigid, arched block capitals.
graphicDevices: Arched baseline for the secondary text line
Grainy halo effect around white elements

preserve: Upward arc of the second line

candidateDirections.reason: For the heavy, rounded weight and vintage feel.
Matches the distorted, organic flow of the script.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, binary black and white image. Center a thin, vertical, ornate totem-like figure with intricate white patterns. In the upper left, place a wispy, textured white smoke cloud. Apply a heavy film grain and 'threshold' filter to ensure no gray tones exist.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of hand-drawn white text in the upper right. The top line should be a thick, lowercase-heavy script. The bottom line should be bold, all-caps sans-serif, following an upward arc. Apply a slight blur and re-threshold to match the grainy texture of the background.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white with no gray?
Is the central figure vertically oriented and centered?
Does the text have a grainy, hand-drawn quality?

adjustableVariables: Density of the ornate patterns on the central figure
Degree of arc on the bottom text line
mustRedesign: Any recognizable faces or specific brand logos
postGenerationChecks: Check for any accidental gray pixels
Ensure the text is legible despite the distortion
Verify the vertical subject is the primary focal point
Confirm the composition feels 'heavy' on the right due to text placement
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a vertically-symmetrical ornate object with an organic cloud form in a 2-bit color space, then anchor with arched hand-lettering in the negative space.
